baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ش ق ق at words 2 and 4 encloses الأرض at word 3, so the clause foregrounds the operation done to the ground.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verb plus cognate accusative presents an agentive, emphatic opening of the lower yet fertile ground. The event is therefore a made aperture, not merely an incidental surface crack.

activation_trace.role: Literal splitting-open supplies the governing operation, while the doubled focus occurrence makes the aperture emphatic.
The lower ground opposite the sky supplies the physical surface that is opened.
Soft fertile ground keeps the opening potentially productive rather than intrinsically destructive.

changed_reading.after: We deliberately and thoroughly open the ground, preparing an aperture in a potentially fertile substrate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: شَقَقْنَا ... شَقًّا can be followed through the focus inventory from division into corresponding sides to a terrain gap associated with growth.
baseline_models.mechanism: A split does not only destroy continuity; it produces two mutually defining edges and an interval between them. In fertile ground that interval can be read as a furrow-like habitat whose sides frame future growth.

activation_trace.role: The half and corresponding-side image turns rupture into a relation between two newly exposed edges.
A gap between sandy ridges together with its vegetation supplies a terrain-scale interval that can host growth.
Fertile ground makes the bounded gap function as a furrow rather than a sterile tear.

changed_reading.before: The ground is broken into disconnected pieces.
changed_reading.after: The ground is parted into corresponding sides that hold open a fertile interval between them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic ش ق ق construction acts upon an الأرض branch characterized by clinging, heaviness, and delay.
baseline_models.mechanism: The opening can be heard as work against inertia: a resistant substrate is made permeable. The dominant hardship branch and the packet's non-dominant ش ق و mapping coexist as two ways of registering the exertion without replacing the ordinary physical sense.

activation_trace.role: A burden that strains the self supplies resistance and effort as the experiential underside of splitting.
The non-dominant mapped branch intensifies the exploratory register of hardship, difficulty, and sustained treatment.
Sticking to the ground and lingering gives the substrate an inertial tendency that the opening overcomes.

changed_reading.before: The ground opens effortlessly as a neutral event.
changed_reading.after: The emphatic split converts a clinging, resistant ground into an accessible and permeable medium.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening scene becomes a material counter-image to the opening social scene: a face contracts and turns away from one who approaches purposefully, whereas fertile ground is made open and thereby becomes capable of growth. The focus remains the ground's aperture, but that aperture now models reception that human attention had withheld.

activation_trace.role: Splitting-open supplies the receptive aperture that anchors the social analogy in the focus wording.
Fertile receptivity supplies the capacity for benefit once the ground is opened.
Facial contraction supplies the initial closure against which the later opened ground is read.
Turning away supplies active refusal of access, the social inverse of making an aperture.
Purposeful movement toward a sought good supplies the approaching element that needs reception.
Growth and increase supply the human-scale outcome that parallels fertile emergence from opened soil.

structural_cues: 80:1-10 repeatedly coordinates approach, attention, facial orientation, and withdrawal before the focus's material opening.
The same surah places hoped-for human growth before the later sequence in which opened ground actually yields growth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: contraction, turning away, purposeful approach, growth, and fertile opening. Reader: the ground's receptivity is a corrective analogue for human receptivity. Alternative: the social and agricultural scenes may be juxtaposed without prescribing this analogy.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports only soil preparation.
changed_reading.after: The opened earth also offers a material model of making access possible: unlike the closed face, it receives an approach and enables growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus aperture becomes a routed conduit. A path is made easy, water is poured downward, and the lower ground is split; together they support a hydraulic reading in which forceful opening changes an obstructing surface into a passage for water.

activation_trace.role: The physical opening supplies the conduit cut through the substrate.
Lower ground supplies both the receiving surface and the downward direction of the routed flow.
An extended traversable path supplies the functional form of the fissure as a route rather than random damage.
Opening and ease after difficulty supply the conversion from resistance to passage.
Pouring and downflow supply the moving material that the earth aperture can conduct.
Delivering water by irrigation or pouring specifies the conduit as hydrological and purposive.

structural_cues: 80:20's eased path precedes the ordered material sequence of poured water, split ground, and growth.
80:25-26 places the water event directly before the emphatic earth-opening event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: traversable path, ease after difficulty, downward pouring, water delivery, and split lower ground. Reader: the fissure routes water into the substrate. Alternative: the water may primarily soften the ground before splitting rather than travel through a discrete channel.

changed_reading.before: The earth is emphatically cracked after rain.
changed_reading.after: The earth is engineered into permeability: its split is an eased route that conducts poured water below the surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split is a controlled emergence gate. Fertile earth and the focus inventory's plant-bearing terrain gap are followed by vegetation and grain; what first looked like damage now functions as the opening through which concealed life crosses the soil boundary.

activation_trace.role: Splitting-open supplies the boundary crossing through the soil surface.
A terrain gap linked with vegetation supplies a focus-internal bridge from fissure to habitat.
Soft fertile soil supplies the medium capable of nurturing what passes through the aperture.
Vegetation coming out of the earth supplies the observed outward result of the focus opening.
The grain that sprouts and bears grain supplies the hidden life whose emergence the fissure enables.
Growth and increase widen germination into a surah-level pattern of latent capacity becoming actual.

structural_cues: 80:25-27 gives a tight water, opening, then growth sequence.
The pronoun in 80:27's فيها returns the growth to the earth opened in the focus ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a vegetated terrain gap, fertile earth, sprouting grain, and earlier growth language. Reader: the fissure is the enabling gate by which buried life emerges. Alternative: the split may denote cultivation generally rather than the shoot's particular passage through soil.

changed_reading.before: The split is force applied to soil.
changed_reading.after: The split is calibrated access across the soil boundary, allowing a latent grain to become visible growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth aperture becomes bidirectional. Burial uses ground to conceal the dead, while نشر supplies both reopening/spreading and revivification; the agricultural fissure can therefore be carried as a material threshold that receives life inward and releases it outward.

activation_trace.role: The ground's literal opening anchors both inward burial and outward release in one physical threshold.
The lower ground supplies the common receiving and releasing medium.
Loss of life supplies the state carried into the ground before any reopening.
Concealing the dead in a grave supplies the inward movement through earth's boundary.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply the reversal of enclosure.
Reviving the dead specifies the released content and makes emergence more than botanical.

structural_cues: 80:21-22 places burial and revival immediately before the command to inspect food and its earth cycle.
The repeated ثم sequencing links human stages and the later water-earth-growth stages without collapsing them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: death, burial, reopening/spreading, revival, and literal earth splitting. Reader: one aperture is treated as a two-way threshold, receiving and later releasing life. Alternative: the human and agricultural cycles may be parallel assurances rather than one material mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus is an agricultural furrow that releases a shoot.
changed_reading.after: The split earth is also a bidirectional grave-threshold: it receives the lifeless and can reopen to release life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ground both covers and discloses. The ك ف ر inventory explicitly joins covering truth with covering seed; the focus breaks fertile cover and the next ayah manifests grain. The material opening can thus act as a counter-covering operation whose visible provision exposes what human denial conceals.

activation_trace.role: Splitting-open supplies the reversal of a covering surface.
Fertile ground supplies a cover that can hide without sterilizing what lies beneath it.
Covering seed supplies the exact agricultural concealment that the focus aperture reverses.
Concealing truth transfers the cover/open contrast into the human indictment without displacing the soil mechanism.
Sprouting grain supplies the hidden content made evident after the cover is broken.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies visible disclosure as the result of opening.

structural_cues: 80:17's human ك ف ر indictment initiates the creation-to-provision sequence that contains the focus.
The same root returns in 80:42 after the focus's hidden grain has become manifest provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: covering truth, covering seed, fertile soil, opening, and emergent grain. Reader: the agricultural uncovering materially answers the human act of covering over. Alternative: the two ك ف ر branches may remain a lexical resonance without a deliberate ethical arrow through the focus.

changed_reading.before: The soil opens so a crop can appear.
changed_reading.after: The soil's opening is a disclosure act: hidden provision breaks cover and becomes evidence against human covering-over.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root's corresponding-side and group-conflict branches become socially live when a person flees his brother. A physical split that creates counterpart sides can now prefigure a final event in which corresponding kin remain related yet occupy separating trajectories.

activation_trace.role: Halves and corresponding sides supply a relation that persists across separation and includes sibling resonance.
A group split by conflict supplies the social realization of a material fissure.
Flight supplies actual movement away from the related counterpart.
Tearing and splitting sharpen flight into a branch-level echo of the focus rupture.
Brotherhood and kinship identify the counterpart relation placed under separation.
The tether image makes flight legible as the failure or severing of a bond.

structural_cues: 80:33's branchless ص خ خ cue marks the abrupt transition from shared provision to separating persons.
80:34 grammatically directs flight away from the brother, preserving relation and separation at once.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: corresponding sides, group fissure, flight, tearing, brotherhood, and tether. Reader: the earth split anticipates a relational split among kin. Alternative: the counterpart branch may be only a focus-root possibility with no intended bridge to 80:34.

changed_reading.before: The two sides of the furrow cooperate around growth.
changed_reading.after: The same two-sided split can darken into a social image: related counterparts remain kin even as the final event drives them apart.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opened earth joins a wider disclosure grammar. The reader is told to direct perception toward food; the ground's surface then opens to expose growth, and later facial surfaces become uncovered, bright, or earth-dusted signs of hidden states. The focus fissure is one instance of an exterior becoming evidentiary.

activation_trace.role: Splitting-open supplies the breach through which a concealed interior becomes perceptible.
The ground supplies the first large surface made evidentiary by opening.
Directed sight or insight frames the material sequence as something to be read, not merely consumed.
Removing a cover supplies the later facial counterpart to opening the earth's cover.
The face as the forward surface supplies the human display plane on which states become visible.
The appearance of skin or surface makes gladness a manifested exterior rather than a hidden possession.
Dust and earth-color place the ground's material directly onto the contrasting human surface.

structural_cues: 80:24 commands inspection before unfolding the hidden production chain behind food.
80:38-41 presents parallel facial surfaces whose visible conditions disclose opposed outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: directed perception, opened ground, uncovered faces, visible skin, and earth-colored dust. Reader: these form a shared surface-disclosure mechanism. Alternative: the facial sequence may disclose judgment independently of the agricultural surface.

changed_reading.before: The ground is opened to let matter pass.
changed_reading.after: The ground is opened so an otherwise hidden process becomes legible; it is the first of several surfaces that disclose their interiors.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final ف ج ر inventory reactivates the focus as a scale model of rupture: wide splitting can release abundance or dawn, but it can also breach a protective or moral cover. The agricultural opening and final transgressive breach remain coexisting, morally unequal realizations of the same aperture geometry.

activation_trace.role: The controlled physical split supplies the focus-scale geometry later enlarged by the final rupture branches.
Fertile ground keeps the focus rupture generative and distinguishes it from a merely destructive breach.
Wide splitting and eruption scale the focus aperture toward sudden, uncontained release.
Dawn breaking from night supplies a revelatory opening rather than simple breakage.
Deviation and breach of a cover supply the morally destructive alternative to the focus's life-enabling opening.

structural_cues: 80:33's branchless ص خ خ cue changes the scale from ordinary provision to the terminal event.
80:42 closes the surah with a root whose branch inventory itself holds generative, revelatory, and transgressive ruptures together.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: controlled fertile splitting and final branches of eruption, dawn, and violated cover. Reader: aperture geometry links the scenes while outcome and moral direction distinguish them. Alternative: ف ج ر may characterize persons only, with no retrospective activation of the earth split.

changed_reading.before: The focus rupture is uniformly beneficent agricultural preparation.
changed_reading.after: The focus becomes the controlled, generative member of a broader rupture family whose final member can expose, erupt, or violate.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ن ش ق mapping for the focus root and transfers a nasal water-drawing image to soil porosity. It remains anchored in the mapped focus occurrence, the earth noun, and the immediately preceding poured water. Render only as an exploratory material analogy, never as a replacement lexical gloss for شققنا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's split-mapped ش ق ق acts on fertile earth immediately after water is poured.

activation_trace.role: Drawing water inward through the nose supplies a form-distant model for fissures admitting water into a porous body.
Soft fertile ground supplies the porous receiving body in the analogy.
Pouring supplies water at the surface for the fissures to admit.
Water delivery by irrigation or pouring makes inward uptake the functional point of the analogy.

changed_reading.before: Water falls onto earth that is then cracked from outside.
changed_reading.after: The fissured earth can be imagined as inhaling the poured water through newly opened passages before giving out growth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a later laughter root contributes a branch for the splitting of a spathe or date cluster, allowing facial expansion and botanical opening to overlap. It remains valid through the focus's literal opening, vegetated-gap branch, and fertile earth. Downstream prose should call it a botanical-expressive echo, not claim that the earth literally laughs.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The literal split and vegetation-linked gap of ش ق ق open the fertile earth in 80:26.

activation_trace.role: Literal opening supplies the common morphology shared by cracked soil and a bursting plant enclosure.
The terrain gap together with its vegetation keeps the expressive image rooted in a botanical habitat.
Fertile ground supplies the living surface whose expansion can be compared to blooming.
The splitting of a spathe and dates supplies a direct botanical opening hidden inside the later laughter root.
Facial expansion supplies the expressive half of the image, turning opening from wound toward visible joy.

changed_reading.before: The earth bears a utilitarian cut for crops.
changed_reading.after: The fertile surface opens like a spathe and, by contained analogy, like a face expanding into a smile: rupture becomes bloom.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it combines the focus inventories' cloth-piece and thick-mat images with contextual sheets, unfolding, and writing. It stays anchored in the earth as a spread surface that is physically opened, but the packet does not call the earth a book. Render as a visual analogy of legibility, not an asserted lexical equation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus pairs a split-off cloth-like piece branch with an earth branch imaged as a thick spread mat.

activation_trace.role: A split-off piece and cloth supply a flexible sheet-like edge for the opened-ground image.
The thick mat supplies the earth as a broad spread surface capable of being parted or folded open.
Breadth and spread supply the shared geometry of page, mat, and ground surface.
A written sheet supplies the legible-surface pole of the analogy.
Opening and spreading supply the action by which a closed surface becomes readable.
Writing or an unfolded written document supplies the explicit folio resonance.

changed_reading.before: The earth is a mute substrate cut open for growth.
changed_reading.after: The spread earth can be pictured as an opened folio whose furrow makes the hidden production of food legible.

strongest_changes: The emphatic crack became engineered permeability: an eased path that routes poured water and opens a gate for grain.
The agricultural aperture became bidirectional when burial and نشر activated earth as both receiver and releaser of life.
The material opening acquired ethical force as the opposite of facial closure and ك ف ر-style covering, while remaining anchored in fertile soil.
The focus's counterpart branches remained live in a separate kinship reading, and final ف ج ر branches preserved a distinct contrast between generative and transgressive rupture.
summary.what_was_special: The split mapping of ش ق ق kept a non-dominant water-inhalation model available, while later roots unexpectedly supplied a bursting spathe, severed kinship, uncovered faces, and an unfolded folio. These activations changed the focus without forcing hydraulic, resurrectional, ethical, social, and textual readings into one synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet supports both water routed through fissures and water softening soil before it splits; the causal direction remains abductive.
Burial and revival may establish a shared mechanism with germination or only a sequence-level analogy.
The kinship and final-breach readings depend on retrospective branch activation more than on local agricultural syntax.
The inhalation, botanical-smile, and folio readings should remain explicitly exploratory rather than lexical glosses.
